criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 18 September 2027 (18 months after the 18 March 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.

Identifies that the Kestrel Engineering Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Flags the 30-day vs 60-day notice-period inconsistency between the SPA and the escrow agreement.
Lists the Kestrel Engineering Ltd change-of-control consent as a required third-party consent and states it has not been obtained.
Assigns a risk rating (High / Medium / Low) to each issue.
